definition.interpretation: The observed divergence ratio (0.229) failed to meet the prediction threshold (1.2), indicating that simple stochastic divergence models are insufficient to capture path-dependent value divergence.
definition.limitations: The current model uses a simplified random seed perturbation which lacks the complex state-coupling required to simulate persistent, memory-driven value formation.
definition.next_step: Revise the hypothesis to account for state-dependence complexity and perform a literature synthesis on path dependence.

definition.reason: Initial tests rule out simple stochasticity; the research must now incorporate structured memory accumulation protocols.
definition.stop_condition: Failure to exceed divergence threshold after structural model integration.
definition.uncertainty: The scaling relationship between internal state complexity and divergent outcomes remains unquantified.
